facts.why: In the film Jack O'Malley is the freelance hacker. Callum Drift is the head of Santa's security, so a call to arms about finding Santa belongs to Callum.

fix_note.text: Santa's missing. Grab a plate and eat fast, nobody at this table sleeps until we find him.

facts.text: Jack O'Malley, head of North Pole security.
facts.why: Jack O'Malley is the hacker who sold Santa's location. Callum Drift is head of Santa's security.
facts.fix: Callum Drift, head of Santa's security.

facts.why: Callum Drift is the Head of North Pole Security who teams up with hacker Jack O'Malley to find Santa, so 'the tracker' is not his role.
The note says it is for Jack O'Malley's shift that has no end. Jack is a hacker, not the security chief. A shift that never ends suits Callum Drift.
facts.fix: Callum Drift's shift has no end.
facts.full: Jack O'Malley's shift has no end.

vibe.verdict: A neat North Pole canteen sheet that is let down by mixing up who Jack and Callum are, and it skips the film's best monsters.
missing: Santa's sleigh and the flying reindeer
